title: CI Failing on Python 3.9 Torch 2.5 due to Upstream `pgmpy` changes
author: zaristei

comments.author: rusty1s
comments.body: We can skip the test for Python < 3.10. Alternatively, we pin `pgmpy` to an earlier version.

comments.author: akihironitta
comments.body: I don't have a strong opinion (since it's only used in our `contrib`), but I'm in favor of pinning `pgmpy` to the last compatible version.

comments.author: XinweiHe
comments.body:
